name: pulse-browser-verification
description: Verifies React component behaviour in the browser for this Laravel Herd/Inertia app. Use for interaction-heavy components, responsive UI, trackpad/mouse/touch gestures, keyboard flows, reduced motion, light/dark modes, image loading, hydration warnings, and visual regressions.
purpose: Validate real browser behaviour across input modes, viewports, and rendering states.
single_responsibility: Verify real browser behaviour of React components across input modes, viewports, and rendering states, preferring Pest Browser tests.
triggers: Component has gestures, scroll, hover, drag, media, animation, overlays, or responsive layout
Hydration warnings or browser console errors are possible
User asks to test desktop, trackpad, mobile, touch, or browser behaviour
completion_criteria: App URL is resolved with Laravel Boost get-absolute-url
Behaviours tied to the change are verified across relevant input modes and viewports
Recent browser logs are checked for client-side errors
Untested device or input classes are disclosed
validation_criteria: Any untested device or input class is disclosed
Console or hydration issues are addressed or reported
failure_handling: If a device, input class, or behaviour cannot be verified locally, stop guessing and report the gap with the expected manual check.
Report what was verified and what was not, including any console or hydration issues.
escalation_path: Route uncertain browser, hydration, gesture, or testing APIs through pulse-docs-research.
Return defects to pulse-implementation or pulse-refactor-safety for fixes.
responsibilities: Use Laravel Boost `get-absolute-url` before sharing URLs.
Assume Laravel Herd serves the app; do not start a separate dev server.
Use browser logs for recent client-side errors.
Prefer Pest Browser tests for browser behaviour verification.
Verify mouse, keyboard, trackpad, touch, reduced motion, and viewport behaviour when relevant.
Check light and dark modes when component appears in both.
Report what was and was not verified.
Verify hydration and console warnings for components with SSR-sensitive render output.
non_responsibilities: Running Herd serve commands; Herd already serves the app.
